verdict.rationale: Docs show strong support for running multiple sessions/agents in parallel (grid of subagent cards, /sessions switching, double-click to jump between agent sessions), but there is no mention anywhere of a visual diff viewer or GUI diff review — Slate is presented as a terminal/TUI tool (npm-installed, hotkeys, slash commands) rather than a graphical desktop app with diff visualization. missing for 10: visual diff review UI, confirmation this runs as a true desktop GUI app rather than terminal TUI, independent corroboration of side-by-side session usability.
